decisions.statement: A deploy that runs in the cluster runs as a job of its own.
A job is named for the subject deployed and the commit it is made at.
A deploy's job is composed the way every job this system runs is composed.
The deploy a job carries runs under no ceiling of the command's own.
The command the job runs is asked of the index rather than spelled.
A job fetches the commit its subject was last deployed at beside the commit it is made at.
Nothing here applies the job to the cluster.
Nothing here reads the workstation's checkout.
Nothing here says what a pod a job starts is given.

definition: the job a deploy runs as, checked out in the cluster at the commit it is made at
